name: Pharmaceutical Sciences, NTA Levels 5–6 (curriculum of 2015)
note: Read from the assessment plans of March 2019, developed from the curriculum of February 2015; the curriculum itself was not on hand, so weekly hours and credits are not given and the outcomes carry no assessment criteria. For students already in NTA Levels 5 and 6, who finish on it (NACTVET BC.220/244/65 of 26 October 2026; Ministry of Health LB.74/262/01B/172 of 27 October 2026). Each semester: 15 weeks of study and 2 weeks of assessment.
